instruction.name: xvreplgr2vr.w
instruction.description: Broadcast the low 32 bits of `val` to all lanes of `dst`.

experiments.name: round trip through the reverse move

latencies.notes: Slope method (--unroll 100000, --unroll2 200000), median of three runs; 6 cycles of flag-helper latency subtracted where the chain closes through x86mtflag/x86mfflag. Measured on 2026-11-17 on LA464, core 0.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvreplgr2vr.w $xr0, $r4; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr1, $r5; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr2, $r6; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr3, $r7; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr4, $r8; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr5, $r9; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr6, $r10; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr7, $r11
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; li.d $r5, 2; li.d $r6, 3; li.d $r7, 4; li.d $r8, 5; li.d $r9, 6; li.d $r10, 7; li.d $r11, 8' --asm 'xvreplgr2vr.w $xr0, $r4; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr1, $r5; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr2, $r6; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr3, $r7; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr4, $r8; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr5, $r9; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr6, $r10; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr7, $r11'
